_about: Voltis's rig settings, read by tools/build_character.py. Parts are listed by position in the flat Figma export art/voltis/Voltis.svg (0-based, [from, to) ranges). The export has no layer names; shapeCount stops the build if it changes.
label: Voltis
_anchor: Where he stands: the centre line of his face and coat, and his soles.
_headPivot: At the chin, inside the beard: the head nods and sways about this point, and the beard, ears, hair and glasses move with it.

inventor.label: Inventor
inventor._legs: Trousers, boots and the boot details.
inventor._arms: By screen side. One piece each, like Nova's: the hand, then the sleeve over it. Each turns at the shoulder dot in the art (3 and 10, not drawn; the other dots 1, 2, 8 and 9 aren't used). No elbow. His arms hang down as drawn: that is his resting pose.
inventor._body: Vest, coat and the coat's button.

_head: The head's layers, back to front, as in Figma. Named layers are part files; pupils, lids, brows and mouth are the shared face rig. His eyes are half covered by a heavy lid (the orange eye shape); the lids close over that whole shape, under his glasses.

_headOutline: Ears, beard, face and hair get the white outline.

face._smile: His drawn mouth (the Mouth frame). It is his idle smile, and the shared mouth shapes are scaled and centred onto it.
face._eyes: Each eye: the round orange eye shape (eyeCircles; the lids close over it) and the white half below it, which the pupils stay inside (pupilClip).
face._lidColors: The orange of his eye shapes.
face._mouthColor: Inside of the talking mouths: the colour of his drawn mouth (near black).
face._lipColor: Ring around the round mouth (F): it matches his face.
face._minStroke: Thinnest line for the rest and closed mouths (X, A) at his size, in canvas units.

_settings: Changes to tools/rig_settings.json for him only. Pupil reach is small: his eye whites are half covered. Full body and close-up are set (the close-up frames his face, from his hair to his beard, for checking lip-sync); knees and waist aren't tuned yet.
